narrative.overview:
The implemented world adapts the publicly available MotionSites Portfolio Cosmic reference: a cinematic midnight scene introduces the person, followed by a quieter gallery of real projects. The serif display voice gives the identity room; the sans-serif reading voice keeps project descriptions and controls practical.

This is a code-led adaptation of the reference's visual grammar, with existing portfolio content and interactions retained. Light mode changes the reading surfaces below the hero while the cinematic hero remains dark.
keyCharacteristics: True black with restrained ice and silver accents.
Large serif headings, compact sans-serif reading text, mono data labels.
Floating capsule navigation and rounded gallery surfaces.
Optional atmospheric motion with a complete static presentation.

rules.name: The Cinematic Hero Rule
rules.body: Keep the hero's dark background and light foreground together in both themes. Do not invert the scene when changing the reading theme.

dos: Do preserve the serif/sans/mono division of roles.
Do keep the static poster readable and complete when motion is unavailable.
Do preserve visible focus, keyboard controls, theme behavior and reduced-motion behavior.
Do use real project imagery and retain embedded asset provenance.
donts: Don't hide essential content behind entrance animation.
Don't apply dark hero colors indiscriminately to light reading surfaces.
Don't treat synthetic demonstrations as evidence of real deployment or outcomes.
Label generated concept artwork as Concept render; never present it as a screenshot or measured result.
narrative.showcase: Uniform equal-height application cards, three/two/one columns at desktop/tablet/phone sizes. 180px icon covers, 96px app-icon tiles with 56px Lucide glyphs. No generated covers or render badges.
